## Skill lifecycle API

An agent-facing API to find, install, run, build and share skills across runtimes.

Ornn is an independent project. It provides skills for agents across runtimes; this overview does not assert that NyxID automatically provisions or connects it.

## Lifecycle

Discover → install → run → build → share.

Skills can support workflows such as presentations, media creation and connected tools. Actual execution depends on the selected skill, its permissions and runtime requirements.

## Technical feature catalogue

The following catalogue is retained from the existing product overview. Runtime availability and service integrations depend on the current release; consult the repository before setup.

## Features

::: {.features-grid}
::: {.feature-card}
### Skill Search

Find skills by what they do, not what they're called. Semantic search plus keyword search plus category browsing.
:::

::: {.feature-card}
### Sandbox Playground

Test any skill before installing it. Interactive playground with Node.js and Python runtimes.
:::

::: {.feature-card}
### Cross-Device Sync

Skill library synchronization is a release-dependent workflow; check the project documentation for current support.
:::

::: {.feature-card}
### Multi-Platform

Works with Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, and Antigravity. One skill library, any agent.
:::
:::


## Build & share

Create, validate and publish skills so other agents can discover and run them. Review each skill's dependencies and permissions before use.
